limitations: Native angular spacing is 0.25 degrees. The metre value is equatorial nominal posting.
Valid elevation can include interpolated cells. No effective feature scale is qualified.
The evidence covers regional elevation context only.

footprints.transform: Canonical planetocentric/east-positive atlas grid. Window selected by the catalog point. Every elevation cell covering the AOI was checked valid; the AOI is inside the display window.
footprints.note: Bounded claim for elevation context. Aggregate count values are retained separately.
